name: Luang Namtha
tagline: Jungle treks and ethnic villages in northern Laos
summary: Luang Namtha is a small valley town in northern Laos and the base for community treks into the Nam Ha protected area. Hike through jungle to Akha and Khmu villages, stay overnight in a homestay, cycle through rice fields to Tai Dam villages, and see the gilded stupa on the hill above town.
seasonNote: November to February is dry and cool; trekking is muddy in the rains.
arrival: Laos-China Railway to Na Teuy, then 30 minutes by road; or buses from Luang Prabang.
gettingAround: Bicycles and scooters; treks with licensed guides.
cashTip: Cash only almost everywhere; carry kip.
foodTip: Khao soi (northern Lao style), jungle meals and the night market.

connections.note: Laos-China Railway to Na Teuy, then road.
